mapper.insert: INSERT INTO falconx_market_analytics.quote_tick ( symbol, source, bid_price, ask_price, mid_price, mark_price, event_time ) VALUES ( #{symbol}, #{source}, #{bidPrice}, #{askPrice}, #{midPrice}, #{markPrice}, fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{eventTimeEpochMillis}, 'UTC') )

INSERT INTO falconx_market_analytics.quote_tick ( symbol, source, bid_price, ask_price, mid_price, mark_price, event_time ) VALUES
( #{record.symbol}, #{record.source}, #{record.bidPrice}, #{record.askPrice}, #{record.midPrice}, #{record.markPrice}, fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{record.eventTimeEpochMillis}, 'UTC') )
mapper.select: SELECT symbol, source, bid_price AS bidPrice, ask_price AS askPrice, mid_price AS midPrice, mark_price AS markPrice, event_time AS eventTime FROM falconx_market_analytics.quote_tick WHERE symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT symbol, source, bidPrice, askPrice, midPrice, markPrice, eventTime FROM ( SELECT symbol, source, bid_price AS bidPrice, ask_price AS askPrice, mid_price AS midPrice, mark_price AS markPrice, event_time AS eventTime FROM falconx_market_analytics.quote_tick WHERE symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) ORDER BY eventTime ASC
